title: Process
description: A workspace's process: its tracks, and its stages in order with each stage's inputs, sequence of workflows, outputs and gate. Each save is a version. Fields this schema does not list are kept as they are, except on a loop and on an input, which list every field they take.

machine.description: The machine type of every workflow entry that sets none: the workspace's default.

tracks.description: Optional. The tracks a gate can offer, for example Standard and Fast track. A condition on a stage, a loop, a workflow entry or an input can test the track that a person chose at an earlier gate.

id.description: Minted once, `st_` and 10 Crockford base32 characters, and never changed.

description.description: Optional. A description of the stage in plain text, at most 500 characters. Line breaks are allowed; pages show the text as it is, without Markdown.

when.description: The stage runs only when its condition is met; otherwise the work item passes over it. Not on the first stage: no earlier stage exists to test.

unless.description: The stage is passed over when its condition is met.

description.description: Optional. A description of the track in plain text, at most 500 characters.

name.description: Optional. A name for this entry in plain text, 1 to 60 characters. Pages show it under the entry.

first_attempt.description: Optional, default false; not allowed in a loop. When the run of this entry ends passed, the rest of the stage's sequence is passed over, and the stage goes on to its output checks and its gate.

access.description: Lowers the access level the stack declares: read, or write-no-push, the level of a workflow that writes in its checkout and has no push credential. Left out, the run has the stack's level.

when.description: The entry runs only when its condition is met; otherwise no run starts for it. A loop whose every entry is passed over is passed over too.

unless.description: The entry is passed over when its condition is met.

when.description: The loop runs only when its condition is met; otherwise it is passed over, with every entry in it.

unless.description: The loop is passed over when its condition is met.

body.description: Workflow entries only: loops do not nest.

when.description: The stage waits for the input only when its condition is met.

unless.description: The stage does not wait for the input when its condition is met.

when.description: The output is required only when its condition is met; otherwise the stage does not check it.

unless.description: The output is not required when its condition is met.

check.description: How the output is checked: it exists, the default, or an adapter reported an outcome for it. A reported check is stored and not checked in this version.

tracks.description: Optional. The ids of the tracks the gate offers; the person who approves picks one. The first id is the default: an approval that picks none records it, unless a run proposed another track the gate offers or the work item is on one the gate offers. A work item on the first track is offered no switch to another track at an escalation. A gate of kind none offers none: a save with tracks on it is refused.

members.description: The ids of the people who approve, from the users table.

condition.description: One test. `{input: T}` is met when the version of the type T that the stage reads has a file of more than 0 bytes; T is an output of an earlier stage. `{track: ID}` is met when the track ID is the one chosen at an earlier gate; an earlier gate offers it.

input_condition.description: Met when the version of the type `input` that the stage reads has a file of more than 0 bytes. `input` is an output of an earlier stage.

track_condition.description: Met when the track `track` is the one chosen at an earlier gate.

track_id.description: One lower-case word, or lower-case words joined by hyphens: fast-track.

machine.description: A machine type of the instance, by its key, or default, the instance's default type. The key may be one the instance has no type for: the runs then start on the workspace's default type.
